svg.title: 70 registered studies on muscle during GLP-1 treatment; 3 have posted results
svg.desc: Resistance or structured exercise: 15 studies, 11 register a strength or function test, 0 with posted results; Experimental muscle drug: 13 studies, 3 register a strength or function test, 1 with posted results; Protein or nutrition product: 10 studies, 4 register a strength or function test, 0 with posted results; Lifestyle program, app or other supplement: 6 studies, 4 register a strength or function test, 0 with posted results; Creatine: 1 studies, 1 register a strength or function test, 0 with posted results; No add-on: what the GLP-1 does to muscle: 25 studies, 15 register a strength or function test, 2 with posted results. Jabbit hand review of ClinicalTrials.gov, October 19, 2026. Lower bound.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 70 registered studies on muscle during GLP-1 treatment. 3 have results.
